snippet.title: Future Proof Survival
snippet.description:
Future Proof Survival is your no-BS guide to mastering self-reliance, prepping, and survival tactics that actually work when things go sideways. We don’t chase trends or peddle paranoia—we deliver real-world skills, gear reviews, and hard lessons to help you stay alive, prepared, and ten steps ahead.

Whether you're going off-grid, building a bug-out plan, or just sick of being dependent on fragile systems, this channel exists to make sure you’re ready for whatever comes next.

Topics We Cover:

Urban & wilderness survival

Tactical prep & gear breakdowns

Off-grid tools & DIY solutions

Crisis response & mindset training

No hype. No fluff. Just brutally honest, field-tested knowledge.

Subscribe if you're serious about staying ready.

snippet.title: Justin Levine: Fit at 50
snippet.description:
Fit at 50 begins…
In 40 months I turn 50, and I want to see what’s possible between now and then. 
The performance goals: a sub-3 marathon, sub-18 5K, an ultramarathon, and some strength standards…but this project goes deeper than performance.

This channel will document…the training, the racing, the dad life, the lifestyle, and the raw, authentic moments that come with trying to pursue big goals while raising a family.

We are grinding just like you: Raising kids, juggling work, chasing goals, and trying to stay active in our community. I don’t have it all figured out, but expect nothing but a real and raw journey. 

At the center of it all is InspireKidz, helping more kids get access to sports and fitness. 
My belief is simple: when parents move, kids move.

If this resonates, support the mission at InspireKidz.org or check out my coaching at JustinLevineCoaching.com.

snippet.title: Trevor Parker
snippet.description:
British prepping, explained plainly.

Trevor Parker covers what UK preppers are actually doing in NOW and why: food stockpiles, power cuts and grid independence, where to live (and where not to), privacy, and what the official emergency advice leaves out.

Each video takes one decision British preppers are making and breaks down the reasoning behind it, so you can decide what makes sense for your own household. No panic, no bunker fantasies, just practical preparedness for ordinary homes in the UK.

On this channel:
• Emergency food and water storage for UK households
• Power cuts, the National Grid and backup energy
• Safest and riskiest UK locations in a crisis
• Keeping your preparations private
• Government guidance vs. what preppers really do

New videos every week. Subscribe if you would rather be ready than sorry.

If you believe in common-sense readiness without the fear, subscribe and join our community!
